main.title: NVIDIA Stock Jumps To Record After Washington Greenlights Chip Exports To China
main.body:
NVIDIA shares climbed to a record $236.46 on Thursday after Washington cleared H200 chip exports to roughly 10 Chinese firms, lifting market value above $5.5 trillion.

The US Department of Commerce signed off on H200 purchases for around 10 Chinese companies, according to Reuters reporting carried by CNBC and Bloomberg.

Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance and JD.com lead the list of cleared buyers, while Lenovo and Foxconn received approval to act as distributors.

Each licensed customer can purchase up to 75,000 H200 units under the terms. The ruling reverses October 2023 export controls that had effectively prevented China from accessing NVIDIA's most advanced inventory. That market previously generated approximately $8 billion in annual sales for the chipmaker.

Beijing is still reviewing the transactions and no physical shipments have left the United States. Chinese firms have pulled back after guidance from authorities in Beijing, according to Reuters. The H200 ranks as NVIDIA's second-most powerful AI accelerator behind the Blackwell line.

NVIDIA chief executive Jensen Huang joined US President Donald Trump in Beijing for the bilateral summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Huang described the meeting as 'one of the most important summits in human history.'

Trump personally called the NVIDIA chief after the executive was initially absent from the White House delegation list, and Huang boarded Air Force One in Alaska before continuing on to Beijing.

Thursday's rally pushed NVIDIA's market capitalization past $5.52 trillion, with the stock gaining roughly 4% on the session, according to Yahoo Finance. The chipmaker now stands as the world's most valuable publicly traded company by a wide margin.

Traders viewed Chinese demand as the missing piece in the data center expansion story. Licensed sales remain subject to a 25% revenue duty paid to the US government and physical inspection inside US territory before export. NVIDIA first crossed the $4 trillion threshold in July 2025 and reached $5 trillion in late October.

main.title: Samsung enters emergency mode ahead of chip union strike
main.body:
Samsung Electronics has activated emergency management procedures in anticipation of an 18-day strike commencing May 21, as its semiconductor labor union prepares for a walkout. The company is reviewing contingency plans including production adjustments and stabilization measures.

Industry analysts warn that a prolonged semiconductor facility shutdown could trigger substantial economic losses. JPMorgan estimates potential losses at approximately 43 trillion won, while worst-case scenarios suggest cumulative damages reaching 100 trillion won ($67 billion). A 2018 precedent highlighted the industry's vulnerability—a 28-minute power outage at Samsung's Pyeongtaek facility cost approximately 50 billion won.

Key Quote: 'Unlike other manufacturing industries, semiconductor plants need to begin production and quality management adjustments a week before a strike even starts in order to minimize the damage.'

The dispute centers on performance-pay reform. The union demands that 15 percent of semiconductor division operating profit be allocated as bonuses with removal of existing salary caps, while Samsung proposes maintaining its current economic value-added system with one-time special bonuses.

Korea's National Labor Relations Commission requested both parties resume negotiations Saturday, representing a final attempt to prevent the company's inaugural full-scale strike, with approximately 50,000 union members expected to participate.

main.title: SK Hynix's AI Memory Supremacy Pushes Valuation Past 1,400 Trillion Won as Samsung Faces Strike Threat
main.body:
SK Hynix achieved a historic market capitalization milestone, crossing 1.4 quadrillion won for the first time. The stock closed at 1,976,000 Korean won, representing a 188% year-to-date surge. The company now trails Samsung Electronics, valued at approximately 1.669 quadrillion won, with analysts suggesting a potential overtaking could occur within weeks.

The South Korean memory chipmaker strengthened its dominance through an exclusive partnership supplying HBM3E memory for Microsoft's Maia 200 AI accelerator—delivering '216 GB of memory capacity and bandwidth of 7 TB/s.' SK Hynix maintains roughly 50% of the global HBM supply market share.

Samsung's position weakened following labor disputes, with the National Labor Relations Commission halting wage negotiations and the union threatening an 18-day strike potentially beginning May 21. Analysts estimate such action could reduce Samsung's operating profit by 7-12%.

SK Hynix is accelerating capacity expansion at its Cheongju facility, targeting 30,000-50,000 monthly wafer units by year-end and 80,000 units next year to meet surging AI-related DRAM demand.

main.title: Microsoft Courts SK Hynix as its Maia 200 AI Chip Raises Memory Stakes
main.body:
Microsoft has courted SK Hynix as Maia 200's 216GB HBM3e design raises memory-supply stakes for AI inference, but no new summit or chip deal is public.

SK Hynix chief executive Kwak Noh-Jung is expected to meet Bill Gates and Satya Nadella during Microsoft's CEO Summit this week. With the summit underway, SK Hynix appears to be aiming at a sole-supplier role for Maia 200, Microsoft's in-house AI inference chip. No Maia 200 supply agreement is public.

Microsoft already places Maia 200 in its heterogeneous AI infrastructure for Foundry and Microsoft 365 Copilot workloads. More HBM supply would let Microsoft widen that hardware lane across more inference demand instead of leaving Maia 200 as a narrower in-house option.

As Maia 200 moves from launch messaging into deployment, Iowa rollout details and a reported 30% better performance per dollar gain already pushed the chip beyond a launch concept earlier in 2026. Lower cost per inference only matters at scale, though, if Microsoft can secure enough memory, packaging capacity, cooling, and board-level supply to build out more complete systems.

Maia 200 uses 216GB HBM3e at 7 TB/s. Stacked high-bandwidth memory keeps large AI models fed with data fast enough to avoid turning expensive compute into idle waiting time.

Each Maia 200 chip is specified at more than 10 petaFLOPS at FP4 within a 750W envelope. Microsoft's earlier Maia generation used far less memory, so the 2026 design marks a meaningful jump in how much data each accelerator can keep close to the compute cores.

As Microsoft moves deeper into custom silicon, Google's TPUs and AWS Trainium already serve training and inference workloads inside rival cloud stacks, while NVIDIA still sets the broader GPU benchmark that hyperscalers are trying to offset rather than fully replace.

Custom ASIC shipments grew 44.6% in 2026, versus 16.1% growth for GPU shipments.

SK Hynix is not negotiating with Microsoft in isolation. The company has been linked to HBM for NVIDIA GPUs and to Google and AWS partnerships, leaving Microsoft to court a supplier that already sits inside several competing ecosystems.

main.title: TSMC 2026 Technology Symposium Hsinchu: From Transistor Scaling to System-Level AI Infrastructure
main.body:
The TSMC 2026 Technology Symposium reveals TSMC's strategic pivot from traditional transistor-focused competition toward comprehensive system-level infrastructure for artificial intelligence.

Market Outlook: The semiconductor market is projected to reach $1 trillion in 2026, accelerating to $1.5 trillion by 2030, with AI and HPC expected to comprise roughly 55% of this market.

Technology Roadmap Highlights:
- Advanced Logic: A14 nanosheet technology (2028) delivers up to 15% speed improvements, while A13 (2029) offers backward-compatible migration paths for customers
- Packaging Innovation: CoWoS packages are expanding to accommodate 20+ HBM stacks by 2028
- 3D Integration: SoIC technology achieves 56x higher connection density than 2.5D alternatives
- Optical Integration: COUPE technology enables co-packaged optics with 10x power efficiency gains
- Wafer-Scale Systems: SoW platforms supporting up to 64 HBM stacks for extreme AI training

Manufacturing Scale: Capacity targets include 70% annual growth for N2/A16 technologies and 80%+ CAGR for advanced packaging through 2027.

Sustainability Focus: TSMC commits to net-zero emissions by 2050 and aims for 70% in-house resource recycling by 2030.

main.title: '몸값 84조' 세레브라스, IPO 돌풍…우버 이후 최대 규모 기록
main.body:
세레브라스가 주당 185달러로 기업공개(IPO)를 성공적으로 완료하며 약 56.4조 원(84조 원)의 기업가치를 달성했다. 회사는 이번 IPO를 통해 최소 55.5억 달러를 조달했으며, 이는 2019년 우버 데뷔 이후 최대 규모 기술 기업 공개 중 하나다.

2016년 설립된 실리콘밸리 AI 칩 제조사는 대규모 AI 연산을 위해 설계된 'WSE(Wafer Scale Engine)' 시리즈를 전문으로 한다. 회사는 NVIDIA 대비 속도와 비용 효율성에서 경쟁 우위를 주장한다.

세레브라스는 2024년 UAE 고객사, 특히 G42에 대한 높은 의존도로 인해 SEC의 조사를 받은 바 있다. 최근 제출 자료에 따르면 G42는 현재 매출의 24%를 차지하며, 또 다른 UAE 기관이 매출의 62%를 담당하고 있다.

회사는 최근 AI 클라우드 서비스로 사업을 전환해 구글 클라우드, 마이크로소프트 애저, 오라클 클라우드와 직접 경쟁하고 있다. 2026년 1월 체결된 OpenAI와의 200억 달러 계약이 시장 신뢰를 크게 높였다.

주요 투자자로는 피델리티 인베스트먼트(약 38억 달러 평가)와 벤치마크 캐피털(약 33억 달러 평가)이 있다.

main.title: 코스피 사상 최초 8000돌파…'만스피' 눈에 보인다
main.body:
남한의 KOSPI 지수가 2026년 5월 15일 역사상 처음으로 8,000포인트를 돌파하며 장중 최고가 8,046.78을 기록했다. 이 이정표는 지수가 5월 6일 7,000포인트를 처음 돌파한 지 단 일주일 만에 달성된 것이다.

이 급등의 주요 원동력은 KOSPI 시가총액의 48%를 차지하는 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스다. AI 혁명과 연결된 메모리 반도체에 대한 전 세계적인 수요 급증으로 인해, 양사는 올해 들어 각각 삼성전자 143%, SK하이닉스 201% 상승했다.

주요 투자은행들은 2026년 KOSPI 목표치를 크게 상향 조정했다. KB증권은 연말 목표치를 7,500에서 10,500포인트로 높였으며, 반도체 선도 기업들의 영업이익이 세 배로 늘어날 것으로 예상했다. JP모건과 다른 주요 금융기관들은 9,000~10,000포인트 사이의 목표를 설정했다.

그러나 삼성전자는 노동 파업 위협으로 인해 역풍을 맞고 있으며, 애널리스트들은 잠재적 손실이 40조원을 초과할 수 있다고 전망했다. 반면 SK하이닉스는 보다 안정적인 궤도를 유지하고 있다.

main.title: Samsung Union Rejects 40 Trillion Won Bonus Offer; Minister Hints at Emergency Arbitration
main.body:
The Samsung Electronics union has rejected a government-mediated bonus proposal worth approximately 40 trillion won, pushing labor negotiations toward collapse just days before a planned 18-day strike beginning May 21.

The National Labor Relations Commission proposed a 40 trillion won package combining existing bonuses with a special performance-based allocation for the Device Solutions division. Union chairman Choi Seung-ho dismissed the offer, stating the NLRC 'talked nonsense' about putting it to a member vote without a preliminary agreement.

Management requires union dialogue with concrete proposals by May 15 morning regarding three core demands: OPI transparency, bonus ceiling elimination, and institutionalization. Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan warned that emergency arbitration appears 'inevitable' if the strike proceeds, citing potential losses of up to 100 trillion won and daily production disruptions of 1 trillion won.

Six major business groups plan issuing a joint statement demanding the union withdraw the strike.

The standoff reflects fundamental disagreement over formalizing bonus structures and removing compensation caps.

competitor_articles.title: US-China Trade Truce May 12: Tariffs Cut to 30%, Chip Controls on the Table
competitor_articles.body:
The US and China announced a trade truce on May 12, 2026, cutting US tariffs on Chinese goods from approximately 145% to 30% and Chinese tariffs on US goods from 125% to 10%. President Trump and President Xi are meeting in Beijing on May 14-15 — the first US presidential state visit to China since 2017.

The May 2026 Beijing summit is happening in a context that makes technology its defining agenda. Past US-China summits have treated technology as a subset of the broader trade relationship. At this summit, the primary trade concession from the US side is a technology export control relaxation, the primary trade concession from China is a critical materials supply chain normalization.

The specific technology-critical items on the negotiating table: AI chip export controls (particularly H200 and future-generation Nvidia GPU licenses), China's rare earth export restrictions imposed in retaliation for the H20 ban, and the antitrust investigations Chinese regulators had opened against US chip companies including Nvidia, Qualcomm, and Intel.

Four Chinese open-weights models were released in a 12-day window in early May: GLM-5.1 from Z.ai, MiniMax M2.7, Kimi K2.6 from Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek V4, which are competitive with Western frontier models on standard agentic engineering benchmarks.

Chinese domestic AI chip market share is projected to hit 50% in 2026. This is not a resolved trade conflict. It is a pause with specific items under active negotiation at the summit.

competitor_articles.title: '몸값 84조' 세레브라스, IPO 돌풍…우버 이후 최대 규모 기록
competitor_articles.body:
세레브라스가 주당 185달러로 기업공개(IPO)를 성공적으로 완료하며 약 56.4조 원(84조 원)의 기업가치를 달성했다. 회사는 이번 IPO를 통해 최소 55.5억 달러를 조달했으며, 이는 2019년 우버 데뷔 이후 최대 규모 기술 기업 공개 중 하나다.

2016년 설립된 실리콘밸리 AI 칩 제조사는 대규모 AI 연산을 위해 설계된 'WSE(Wafer Scale Engine)' 시리즈를 전문으로 한다. 회사는 NVIDIA 대비 속도와 비용 효율성에서 경쟁 우위를 주장한다.

세레브라스는 2024년 UAE 고객사, 특히 G42에 대한 높은 의존도로 인해 SEC의 조사를 받은 바 있다. 최근 제출 자료에 따르면 G42는 현재 매출의 24%를 차지하며, 또 다른 UAE 기관이 매출의 62%를 담당하고 있다.

회사는 최근 AI 클라우드 서비스로 사업을 전환해 구글 클라우드, 마이크로소프트 애저, 오라클 클라우드와 직접 경쟁하고 있다. 2026년 1월 체결된 OpenAI와의 200억 달러 계약이 시장 신뢰를 크게 높였다.

주요 투자자로는 피델리티 인베스트먼트(약 38억 달러 평가)와 벤치마크 캐피털(약 33억 달러 평가)이 있다.

competitor_articles.title: 알리바바 "이익보다 AI 점유율 우선"...공격적 투자 선언에 주가 급등
competitor_articles.body:
대규모 AI 투자로 인한 상당한 이익 감소에도 불구하고, AI와 클라우드 운영에서의 성장 신호에 투자자들이 긍정적으로 반응하면서 알리바바 주가가 급등했다.

알리바바는 1분기 기준 조정 EBITA가 51억 위안(약 1.1조 원)으로 전년 대비 84% 감소했다고 보고했다. 이는 즉석 배달과 AI 인프라 확장에 대한 공격적인 투자에 기인하며, 이커머스 조정 EBITA는 40% 하락했다.

당초 실적 발표 이후 주가는 장전 거래에서 약 4% 하락했다. 그러나 경영진이 AI 수익화 전략을 강조하면서 심리가 반전되어 거래 중 주가가 7% 이상 상승했다.

Eddie Wu CEO는 밝혔다: '향후 3~5년간 AI 투자 수익률 전략은 명확하다. 시장 점유율과 리더십이 우선 순위이며, 수익성은 부차적이다.'

알리바바는 3년간 3,800억 위안의 AI 투자를 약속했으며, 급증하는 수요로 인해 실제 지출이 이를 초과할 수도 있다.

Cloud Intelligence Group 매출은 38% 증가한 416억 위안이었으며, 조정 EBITA는 57% 상승했다. AI 제품은 11분기 연속 세 자릿수 성장률을 기록했으며, AI 전체 매출은 90억 위안에 달했다.

알리바바는 Qwen AI 모델 시리즈와 반도체 개발을 통한 공격적인 경쟁 포지셔닝을 추구하며, 자국 칩 공급 통합 역량을 통한 중국 시장에서의 독특한 강점을 주장하고 있다.

competitor_articles.title: Trump-Xi summit updates: US, China leaders hold talks on trade, tech, Iran
competitor_articles.body:
President Trump arrived in Beijing on May 13, 2026 for summit meetings with President Xi Jinping on May 14-15 — the first US presidential state visit to China since Trump's own November 2017 trip. The summit follows the May 12 trade truce that cut US tariffs from 145% to 30% and Chinese tariffs from 125% to 10%.

The technology and semiconductor items on the negotiating table include: whether H200 GPU exports to China get a formal licensing framework, what China concedes on rare earth export restrictions, and whether a bilateral AI governance framework gets signed.

Initial Summit Outcomes: The U.S. and China agreed to forge more cooperative ties on the first day of summit, according to Beijing's official English readout, striving to build a 'constructive China-U.S. relationship of strategic stability.' The White House said President Donald Trump had a 'good meeting' with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing, highlighting discussions on expanding economic cooperation and market access for U.S. businesses.

Jensen Huang (NVIDIA), Elon Musk (Tesla/SpaceX), Tim Cook (Apple), and Larry Fink (BlackRock) attended the summit. Other tech-specific negotiations focused on semiconductor export controls, rare earth supply, and AI governance.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: 트럼프-시진핑 베이징 정상회담(5/14-15), H200 라이선스·희토류·AI 거버넌스 핵심 의제, Huang·Musk·Cook 동행 — 반도체 수출 통제 프레임워크 분기점.

competitor_articles.title: Nvidia's Record Run Hinges on China Access and a May 20 Earnings Test
competitor_articles.body:
Nvidia's stock reached record territory at $220.78 on May 13, 2026, up 12% over five trading sessions. The rally reflects investor optimism about potential China market access and upcoming earnings results.

CEO Jensen Huang joined President Trump's Beijing visit, raising hopes that frozen H200 AI-chip sales restrictions might ease. As one analyst noted, 'Keeping the status quo would already count as good news,' signaling the stock's sensitivity to diplomatic developments.

Management forecasts Q1 fiscal 2027 revenue of approximately $78 billion, explicitly excluding Chinese data-center revenue. The May 20 earnings call could provide clarity on Blackwell demand and China strategy.

Analysts like Susquehanna's Christopher Rolland raised price targets to $275, citing strong AI infrastructure demand. However, skeptics highlight valuation concerns, rising interest rates, and competitive pressure from AMD, Broadcom, and Alphabet's custom chips.

Higher inflation concerns and Iran-conflict anxiety weighed on broader markets, yet Nvidia bucked the trend, suggesting investors believe company-specific catalysts outweigh near-term economic risks.
